notes.title: An update on Jumping Jazz Cats' Release Date ⬇️🐈
notes.notes:
Today, we have some difficult news to share, as [b]we've made the decision to delay Jumping Jazz Cats- stay tuned for our new release date soon.[/b]
 
In the meantime, [b]we have returned our free-to-play demo to Steam so you can get your paws into our cat parkour levels and experience some of Jumping Jazz Cats' features![/b] Our demo includes two of our six mini-games in online play, the first chapter of our offline play game mode in Solo Trials, and more. 
 
Our aim for Jumping Jazz Cats has always been to provide you with the best online party game experience, and we need some extra time to deliver this to you. We are deeply sorry to delay your Jumping Jazz Cats party invite for a little longer! 
 
Our team are focused on polishing the game before setting a new release date. When we have news to share about the release of our cat party game, we’ll update you on our @LeCatCo X account and on Steam! 
 
We appreciate all your support and we hope you continue to follow the journey of our pawesome kitties in Jumping Jazz Cats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565692/fe8c90bd00a769e2b58126108f37df9a5597eb1b.png[/img]
[h3] Experience our Jumping Jazz Cats demo! 🎮[/h3]

[b]Try out our kitty parkour party game today via our demo![/b] You'll experience two of our six mini-games in Fat Cat and Gimme Yarn, three Song Events which change the choruses of rounds, the first chapter of our solo-trials game mode for offline play, and more.

[h3]Play the demo! 👇[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951780/Jumping_Jazz_Cats/

[i]Please note, this demo build is the same as our Steam Next Fest demo build. You may see some mentions of Steam Next Fest during your demo playthrough, which we are aware of! 😺[/i]
